errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Общо работни часове на седмица, включително извънреден труд (средно)“
errors.evidence: The label on the vertical axis in the figure does not mention 'включително извънреден труд'; it says 'изключително извънреден труд'.
In Finland, the figure shows values of 41.84 for men and 34.9 for women, not 37.64 for men.
In Hungary, the figure shows values of 44.33 for men and 41.85 for women, so while it seems correct, cross-verification insists checking all statements for accuracy without assuming correctness.
In Slovakia, the figure shows values of 44.58 for men and 40.4 for women, not 43.13 for men.
The description does not mention the units on the y-axis as 'hours'.
